translation.The Anthropic Messages API, wire-compati: The Anthropic Messages API, wire-compatible with Anthropic clients. This is the endpoint Claude Code and other Anthropic-native agents use.
translation.The OpenAI Responses API — the newer sta: The OpenAI Responses API — the newer stateful format used by Codex and other agent-first tools. It accepts a simple input and returns a structured output list.
translation.The account or organization that owns th: The account or organization that owns the model record.
translation.The convenience field output_text concat: The convenience field output_text concatenates all output_text parts — that is what the SDK samples print.
translation.The conversation so far, as an array of: The conversation so far, as an array of role and content messages.
translation.The edits endpoint takes multipart/form-: The edits endpoint takes multipart/form-data: upload the source image plus a prompt describing the change.
translation.The examples in these docs read the key: The examples in these docs read the key from this variable.
translation.The gateway address with /v1 appended, e: The gateway address with /v1 appended, e.g. https://your-site.example.com/v1.
translation.The gateway also serves the Anthropic Me: The gateway also serves the Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses formats — see the Model access API section if your tool prefers those.
translation.The image model to use; see Model Square: The image model to use; see Model Square for the models enabled on this site.
translation.The input to act on: a plain string, or: The input to act on: a plain string, or a list of typed message items.
translation.The key may not use this model or endpoi: The key may not use this model or endpoint, or the request was blocked by content policy or an IP restriction.
translation.The main text inference endpoint, compat: The main text inference endpoint, compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API. Send a conversation, get a completion — or stream it token by token.
translation.The maximum number of tokens to generate: The maximum number of tokens to generate before stopping.
translation.The model identifier to pass as the mode: The model identifier to pass as the model parameter in requests.
translation.The usage field is included in the final: The usage field is included in the final chunk only when you also pass stream_options: {"include_usage": true}.
translation.This gateway exposes one OpenAI- and Ant: This gateway exposes one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API for every model it serves. Create an API key, pick an endpoint format, and point your favorite tool at it — no per-vendor accounts required.
translation.To avoid exporting on every shell, put t: To avoid exporting on every shell, put the same variables into the env block of the Claude Code settings file.
Unexpected upstream or gateway failure. Safe to retry with backoff.
translation.Unix timestamp (seconds) when the model: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the model record was created.
translation.Unlike OpenAI-format endpoints, max_toke: Unlike OpenAI-format endpoints, max_tokens is required here, and the recommended authentication headers are x-api-key plus anthropic-version.
translation.Upper bound for the number of output tok: Upper bound for the number of output tokens generated.
translation.Upper bound for the number of tokens gen: Upper bound for the number of tokens generated in the completion.
translation.Use any OpenAI-compatible SDK, CLI, or a: Use any OpenAI-compatible SDK, CLI, or app with the gateway.
translation.Use exponential backoff with jitter, and: Use exponential backoff with jitter, and cap retries at a few attempts. The OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs do this automatically when configured with max_retries.
translation.When creating a key you can restrict it: When creating a key you can restrict it to specific models, channel groups, IP ranges, and quotas, and set an expiry. Requests that exceed a limit fail with a 429 response — see Errors for the exact format.
translation.With response_format: b64_json the data: With response_format: b64_json the data items carry b64_json instead of url. Image generation is billed per output image; check Model Square for pricing.
translation.With stream: true the endpoint emits typ: With stream: true the endpoint emits typed SSE events: message_start, one or more content_block_start / content_block_delta / content_block_stop groups, then message_delta with the final stop reason and usage, and message_stop.
